description:
One day, a suspected patient with the Ars24 variant that was brought to Korea University Hospital escaped. Professor Jung Yu-Hyeon of the Department of Infectious Diseases, who felt responsible for losing the patient he was in charge of, decided to jump into the search for the patient and headed to Surak Village in Hwaseong City, where the patient was last seen. And they encountered something at the entrance to the village..., a man with a height of 2m, a body much larger than that of an average adult male, a corpse of an animal in his hand, clothes stained with blood and torn, and a face that was hard to identify as old. The search team was momentarily overwhelmed by the man's appearance. And Jung Yu-Hyeon discovered that there was a connection between the man's strange appearance and the unusual symptoms that the patient who escaped had shown at the hospital...

(Source: Naver, translated)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*
